NAME:
   rancher images - List container images in use, grouped by image or owning workload

USAGE:
   rancher images [flags]

FLAGS:
   --all-clusters                     read the pods of every cluster you can list
   --by string                        Group by unique image or by owning workload (default: image)
   --cluster id|name                  target cluster id|name; pass exactly one of --cluster or --all-clusters
   --help, -h                         show help
   --match substr [ --match substr ]  Show only images whose reference contains substr (repeatable, OR)

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
